ValidationRule.description: Cannot change Status if set to Mod Requested
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Cloud_uAssist_Order", NOT($Permission.Bypass_uAssist_Status_Validation),
ISCHANGED(uAssist_Status__c),
ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(uAssist_Status__c), "Modification Requested"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Modification in Progress")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Modification Complete")),
CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "uAssist") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot change Status if set to Mod Requested
